nodes.name: 歪的印
who: the gate guard with the crossed spear
nodes.light: low warm gold of a summer evening from the left, with cool blue shadow inside the gate arch, and a faint straw-coloured glow at the stamped cloth
nodes.camera: at the height of the cart bench, a little to the side, looking across the cloth corner toward the guard; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: evening in high summer at the west gate of a walled wheat-country city, the stone gate arch lit gold on its outer face. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a two-wheeled cart with a patched canvas cover stands in the gateway; one corner of the cover is turned back to show pale rounds of cheese, three stoneware jars and a small barrel. An old grey mare stands in the shafts with its head low and one forefoot lifted, stopped by itself under the arch. On the driver's bench sits Bran, a halfling carter of about forty, small and round, barely as tall as the cart wheel: pale gold curls under a soft cap, a round smiling face, light spring-green eyes squeezed to slits, a charcoal stick between his short fingers; he has just woken from a doze and sits up straight. Facing him left of centre stands Katrin, the gate guard, a tall lean woman of thirty seen in profile: glossy blue-black hair cut at the chin, an old scar cutting her left eyebrow, deep ink-blue eyes that do not blink, a leather cuirass with a badge of a bridge wound with wheat, a long spear with a straw-coloured tassel held crosswise in her left hand. With her right hand she presses a small bronze stamp onto the cloth corner, right beside an older black ink mark; her new mark sits crooked and slightly tilted, and both marks glow with a soft straw-coloured light. Behind her inside the gate a short queue of villagers with bundles of firewood and two sheep waits in shadow. Beyond the cart outside, the road runs away across ripening wheat to a second walled city, small and far on the horizon, a thin line of smoke over its tower. Drifting wheat chaff and dust lit gold float large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是一幕幕终两个印挨上的那一下（源稿第217行），印盖歪见第214行。栗林城的印是黑墨，卡特琳的印是麦秆色。

nodes.name: 杆外的信
nodes.light: a single warm torch from the left on the steward, deep blue night elsewhere, and the straw-coloured glow of the stamped cloth on the right
nodes.camera: low, at the level of the cart bench, over the whip handle in the near foreground, looking at the steward; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the east gate of a walled city, a stone arch with a torch burning in a bracket. In the near foreground a long whip handle of pale wood is held horizontally across the front of a small cart, large and sharp, running right across the lower third of the picture like a bar. On the cart bench at the right sits Bran, a halfling carter of about forty, small and round: pale gold curls under a soft cap, a round face with a patient half-smile, light green eyes narrowed, his short fingers holding the other end of the whip handle. Beyond the whip handle, standing in the gateway at arm's length, is a thin city steward of about fifty in a long dark coat with spotless cuffs, a bald forehead and a courteous bent head. He holds out a sealed letter with both hands; it is pushed right up to the whip handle and stopped there, not one finger's breadth beyond it. The wax seal on the letter has just caught a tongue of fire, a tiny flame jumping up from the red wax where he pressed a bleeding fingertip, and its light is on his lowered face. At the right corner of the cart's cloth cover, two ink stamps side by side glow a soft straw colour, steady, lighting the cart bench. A grey old mare in the shafts stands with its ears turned back, calm. Behind the steward the gate passage is empty and dark, one lamp burning far down it. Sparks from the torch and thin straw dust drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是二幕第一拍，管家夜里拦车、信停在杆外（源稿第220行）。管家照第257行写（五十来岁，瘦，袖口干净）。

nodes.name: 车底的脚
who: the gate guard with the crossed spear
nodes.light: cold grey-blue winter dawn from the right, a weak orange torch glow from the left on the guard's cheek
nodes.camera: at ground level beside the cart wheel, looking along under the cart bed toward the guard's boots; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter morning at the west gate of a besieged city, thin snow on the cobbles and a wall of grey sky above. We lie at ground level beside the near wheel of a two-wheeled cart and look along the space under the cart bed. Wedged against the axle beam in the middle of the picture, two small bare feet, a child's, curled up, blue with cold, the toes gripping the wood; nothing else of the child is seen, and the dark under the cart bed hides the rest. Beyond the cart at the left stand the boots and lower legs of Katrin, the gate guard, a tall lean woman of thirty-two with glossy blue-black hair cut at the chin and an old scar across her left eyebrow, ink-blue unblinking eyes; she is just straightening from stooping, her left hand still holding up the corner of the canvas cover so that grey light falls under the cart, her long spear with a straw-coloured tassel in her right hand, the point lowered to the snow. She looks straight at the feet. Her face is hard and shut, and on the tip of her spear a small straw-coloured light does not flicker. At the right, high on the bench above the wheel, sits Bran the halfling carter, small and round, in a soft cap with pale gold curls, looking straight ahead along the road and saying nothing, a charcoal stick in his hand. A row of shuttered, cold houses with no smoke stands behind the gate. Far past the gate, small and out of focus, a besieging camp of tents and a line of campfires on the white wheat stubble. Fine snow and breath mist drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是三幕卡特琳掀开布看见车底下那一双脚（源稿第231行）。孩子八岁，只画一双脚，不画身子和脸。

nodes.name: 挨着的印
who: the gate guard with the crossed spear
nodes.light: last rose-gold light of an early-spring evening from behind the temple, with a lamp burning above the temple door
nodes.camera: at the cart's height, from the front corner of the cart, looking toward the temple door; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early-spring dusk before the gate of a small stone ward-fire temple standing alone in the middle of a road across wheat country, a single lamp burning above its door. A two-wheeled cart with a patched canvas cover stands in the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame; Bran the halfling carter, small and round in a soft cap with pale gold curls, sits on the bench with his hands in his lap and a quiet smile, the old grey mare in the shafts. Beside the cart, left of centre, a thin old count of about sixty stands with one hand stretched out and touching the cloth corner: grey cropped hair, a long dark cloak, hollow cheeks, a bare metal circlet on his head with three empty gem sockets. His fingertips rest on two ink stamps side by side on the cloth, a black one and a straw-coloured one, which glow softly under his hand. He says nothing and looks at the marks. A step behind him on the right stands Katrin, a tall lean woman of thirty-three in leather armour with glossy blue-black hair cut at the chin and a scarred left eyebrow, her spear held upright at her side, her ink-blue eyes on the count. Two horses with empty saddles stand at the temple wall, one with a dark red blanket. On the far horizon, left and right, two beacon towers on two distant walls stand dark, with no fire and no smoke, and between them a faint line of mist lies over the unreaped wheat. Wheat seeds and a few thin curls of lamp smoke drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是收束里栗林城伯爵出院门时停在车边、摸那两个挨着的印（源稿第241行）。伯爵照第256行写（六十来岁，瘦），冠上三颗红玉在二幕已换了粮，所以画空座。

nodes.name: 第十步
nodes.light: hard white-gold noon sun from above and behind, long dark shadows of the grass, a cold shadowed plateau cliff far above
nodes.camera: low in the grass behind the houndmaster, looking along the open stretch toward the far camp; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: noon in early autumn on a long yellowing grass slope below a high plateau, the knee-high grass bending in one long wave toward the right. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands Tahe, a lean wolf-eared houndmaster of eighteen seen from behind at three-quarter: untidy grey-black hair, two upright wolf ears silver-grey on the backs, an old dog-scratch scar down one cheek, a fur vest, a coil of dog leads at his belt, a short bow on his back; his arm is flung across his chest and a bone whistle is held crosswise between his lips. Ahead of him over the open stretch of grass about twenty hunting dogs have been loosed: the lead dog, a big grey one, is caught high in the air at the top of its leap, all four legs tucking as the whistle sounds, while the rest of the pack behind it has dropped flat to the grass in one straight line, only their ears showing above the stems. On the far right, small, across a mile of open grass, a line of deer-eared archers with bows drawn and arrows nocked stand in front of tents hung with fresh hides; a thin man with a piece of antler tucked into his temple hair stands in front of them. Behind and on the left a few grey tents. Far above on the cliff the wind wall streaks the sky with long pale bands of cloud. Seeds, stalks and torn grass blades whirl large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是一幕第三天正午，塔赫横过骨哨、领头的狗在半空缩腿（源稿第292行）。头像不画狼耳首领，只在远处写鹿耳那边的人。

nodes.name: 她的路
nodes.light: clear morning sun from the left over yellow grass, a faint pale glow rising from the worn path
nodes.camera: low and ahead of the runner, looking back at her along the path as she comes toward us; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: morning on a long grass slope in early autumn, the grass yellow and knee-high, and down the middle of it a narrow bare strip of trodden earth running straight away from us, shining with a faint pale light. Running down this strip toward us and already close is Naka, a fox-eared messenger of twenty: a long red-fox ponytail flying high, two fox ears with white tufts at the tips, the left one notched with a healing scab where a piece is missing, amber eyes wide, a small cheeky fang and freckles on her nose, a short deerskin jacket with strips of coloured cloth sewn on its sleeves, leggings, soft deerskin shoes, a deerskin satchel on her back patched with several mismatched pieces. She is mid-stride, both feet off the ground, laughing and talking as she runs. On both sides of the path, far to left and right, long lines of archers stand in the grass, wolf-eared on one side, deer-eared on the other, and every bow is lifted by a hand's breadth, arrows tipped up toward the sky and none pointing at the runner. Some thirty paces behind her, small in the middle distance, runs Tahe, a lean wolf-eared youth of eighteen with untidy grey-black hair and a scarred cheek, one hand stretched out toward her back, a big grey dog at his heel with its mouth shut. Dry grass seeds and bits of straw whirl large and out of focus in the near corners.
nodes.note: 选的是二幕第五天，小道发着浅光、两边的弓梢都抬高一寸，塔赫跟在后头（源稿第297行）。娜卡成年，左耳缺口画成结了痂，不画血。

nodes.name: 各走半里
nodes.light: cold pale blue-white of dawn mist all around, with the faint glow of the path in the grass as the only warm note
nodes.camera: low to the ground behind the kneeling girl, looking along the glowing path into the mist; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn on a grass slope drowned in white mist, the air cold and still. In the near foreground at the lower left, seen from behind at three-quarter, Naka the fox-eared runner kneels in the grass with one hand pressed flat to the ground: a long red-fox ponytail fallen over her shoulder, two fox ears with white tufts and the left one notched, a short deerskin jacket, a patched deerskin satchel on her back, her head bowed. Under her knees and running away from her to both left and right, a narrow trodden path glows with a faint pale light; at its two ends, far off in the mist, stand two white-peeled poles, just visible. Down this glowing line two men are walking toward her, one from each side, each only half visible in the fog: on the left a tall grey-haired man of fifty with grey-white wolf ears, one ear notched, his bow hanging lowered in one hand; on the right a thin man of forty with a piece of antler tucked into the hair at his temple, his bow lowered in his hand as well. Behind them, dim shapes of tents and a standing crowd, bows still at the ready and no one moving. At the right, ten paces behind Naka, Tahe, a lean wolf-eared youth of eighteen with untidy grey-black hair and a scarred cheek, stands very still, his hand lifted toward the pack that has dropped flat in the grass; a big grey dog has come out alone from the stems and lies down beside the kneeling girl. Fine mist droplets and a few grass blades drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是三幕她跪在草里、两位首领各走半里过来、灰狗趴到她身边（源稿第306到308行）。两位首领没有立绘，照人物条写样子。

nodes.name: 一声骨哨
nodes.light: red-gold light of a late-autumn sunset from the right, long blue shadows of the grass, a pale glow in the path
nodes.camera: from the top of the slope behind Tahe, looking down along the path; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunset on a grass slope in late autumn, the grass turned from green to dull gold. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, Tahe stands at the top of the slope seen from behind at three-quarter: a lean wolf-eared youth of nineteen with untidy grey-black hair and two upright silver-grey wolf ears, a fur vest, a bone whistle just lowered from his mouth; his left hand is raised halfway toward his left ear. Around his feet and down the slope behind him, about twenty hunting dogs have all sat down at once in a ragged row, every head turned to look the same way, a big grey dog in front. Far down the slope, small, along a narrow trodden path that glows faintly pale from end to end, walks Naka the fox-eared runner, seen from behind: a long red-fox ponytail swaying, fox ears with white tufts, the left ear notched with a scabbed edge, a deerskin satchel with several patches on her back; she walks east and does not look back, one hand raised in farewell. At the north end of the path a white-peeled pole stands in the grass, and at the south end another; on the slope beside them lie the flattened marks of struck tents, and a few archers who have just lowered their bows are walking down onto the path. Far behind the slope a plateau cliff stands dark against the red sky. Drifting grass seeds and thin dust, lit red, drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 选的是收束里她走的那天，塔赫吹了一声骨哨、狗一齐坐下看着她走（源稿第318行）。他左手摸耳朵是往后的习惯（第714行），这里只抬到一半，不写成已摸。

nodes.name: 空担架
who: the beast-eared hunter who flinches at thunder
nodes.light: pale cold blue of snow at dusk, with a single flash of white lightning at the far horizon and warm orange from pine-branch fires
nodes.camera: low, from the ground between the stretchers, looking along the row at the two hunters; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early-winter dusk in a hunters' village of stone houses huddled under a high cliff, the roofs weighted with slates, thin snow falling. A frozen waterfall hangs in mid-air at the cliff edge like an inverted icicle, and the wall of the wind streaks the sky above. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, lies a row of seven empty stretchers of poles and rope laid side by side on the cleared stones, a pine-branch fire smoking at the end of the row, its smoke torn off by the wind. In the middle of the picture on the left stands Toka, a beast-eared hunter of thirty, long-legged and narrow-shouldered, seen in three-quarter: short silver-grey hair, grey beast ears with black tips laid flat, pale gold eyes; a rope with no splice in it coiled around his waist; he is caught in the instant after a far flash of lightning, his shoulders hunched up to his ears, his jaw set. Facing him on the right stands Inri, a human archer of nineteen, 166 cm, in a leather coat with a collar of down: a long pale flax braid with a storm-hawk feather tied in the tip, grey-blue eyes, cheeks reddened by wind, her short bow held across her chest, her mouth open in a loud laugh at him, one hand pointing, her laugh the loudest thing in the picture. Behind them a few older hunters with white beards stand silently with their arms folded beside the stretchers. Large soft snowflakes drift in the near corners, and sparks from the fire fly the other way.
nodes.note: 选的是一幕里茵莉笑托卡怕雷、七副空担架摆在村口（源稿第363行和开局第354行）。托卡的立绘在纷争纪那一套（z3_toka）。

nodes.name: 头顶一箭
who: the beast-eared hunter running with a rope
nodes.light: black storm dark all around with a hard white flash of lightning from the right behind Toka, cold blue on the ice
nodes.camera: low behind and below the fallen girl on the ledge, looking up the ice slope past her bow at the runner; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the fifth day of a pursuit across a high ice slope in a plateau storm, the sky pitch black though it is day. At the top of the picture an immense mass of black cloud presses down over the plateau, and in the cloud a face is twisting itself out of the cloud, two white flashing eyes, a mane full of lightning; one fork of white lightning cracks into the ice on the right. On a ledge in the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, Inri lies half sitting, a human archer of nineteen with a long pale flax braid whipped by the wind, a storm-hawk feather in its end, grey-blue eyes, in a leather coat with a down collar: one leg bent wrong under her where she has fallen down a drop, her teeth set; she has just loosed an arrow with her short bow drawn out toward the upper right, and the arrow is flying low above Toka's head to tell him not to turn. Up the slope in the middle of the picture, Toka, a beast-eared hunter of thirty with short silver-grey hair, grey beast ears with black tips flattened against his skull, pale gold eyes, a rope with no splice coiled round his waist, a plain fur-collared coat, caught half-turned, one foot on the ice, his head turned back over his shoulder toward her, and the arrow passing a hand above him. Behind him a long file of figures has dwindled to a few small dark dots strung out down the slope. Ice crystals, snow and sparks of lightning rush past large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是二幕第五天茵莉摔下坎、朝托卡头顶射箭叫他别回头（源稿第379行）。她腿断了，只画腿弯得不对，不画血。风暴兽照第一阶画黑云里一张脸。

nodes.name: 倒雨
who: the beast-eared hunter on its back
nodes.light: blinding white and violet lightning from every side against pitch black, with the faint blue of the first dawn at the very top edge
nodes.camera: just behind and above the man, wide-angle, looking forward along the beast's back toward its head and the sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in the high sky, in the heart of a storm. A beast made of black storm cloud is rising straight up through thunder; we look along its back from behind, the ridge of its back a mass of dark cloud flesh with a mane full of white and violet lightning that runs away from us toward its half-formed head, far ahead, where two white eyes flash. In the near middle of the picture, Toka, a beast-eared hunter of thirty, lies flat along the beast's back with his arms wrapped around its mane: short silver-grey hair torn by the wind, grey beast ears with black tips flat against his head, his eyes shut tight and his face pressed into the mane, his fur-collared coat soaked and torn at one shoulder. A long rope with no splice is wound tight around his right wrist and knotted into the mane; the rope glows faintly. Lightning does not fall: from the village far below, tiny and out of focus in the lower corner, every fork of white and violet lightning runs upward from the ground into the cloud, like rain falling the wrong way, and the arcs on every side bend toward him and the beast in curved bright branches. At the top edge of the picture a thin line of cold blue marks the coming dawn. Streaks of cloud and sparks rush past large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是三幕他趴在它背上、雷从低处往高处走（源稿第386到388行）。风暴兽用第二阶参考。托卡两眼闭着，源稿写两眼一片墨黑。

nodes.name: 一根毛
who: the flax-braided archer on a crutch
nodes.light: gold sunlight breaking through a split in the black cloud from the upper left, falling on green grass, with the beast's mane still flickering violet
nodes.camera: low, from the grass at the girl's side, looking up at the man and the beast's head behind him; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: morning on top of a high cliff, the last of a black storm cloud splitting open overhead from one edge to the other and a wide beam of gold sunlight pouring down onto the wind wall and the green grass behind it, the young grass showing in patches across the slope. In the middle of the picture, left of centre, stands Toka, a beast-eared hunter of thirty, seen from the front at three-quarter: short silver-grey hair, grey beast ears with black tips, pale gold eyes, a fur-collared coat newly sewn with a very tight collar, a rope with no splice coiled round his waist. His right hand rests on the mane of the great storm beast that stands behind him, a huge dark mass whose cloud-body is pale grey and thin, its head lowered to his shoulder, its two white eyes half shut; the last violet arcs of lightning run along its mane and are drawn into it one by one. With his left hand Toka holds out to a young woman one single hair from that mane, which crackles with a tiny violet spark. She stands near the right foreground, partly cut off by the frame: Inri, a human archer of nineteen, 166 cm, leaning on a wooden crutch with one leg stiffly braced, a long pale flax braid with a storm-hawk feather tied at its end, grey-blue eyes bright and wet, one corner of her mouth just lifting, her hand reaching for the hair. Far below the cliff small village roofs and thin smoke show through gaps in the cloud. Wisps of torn cloud and small violet sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是收束里他从兜里掏出一根它鬃毛里落下来的毛交给茵莉（源稿第394到397行）。风暴兽用第二阶参考，这里它是平静的。

nodes.name: 空勺
nodes.light: a row of warm candles along the long table, deep brown-black shadow in the vaulted cellar, and a faint warm haze rising through cracks in the floor
nodes.camera: from the near end of the table at the cook's elbow, looking down the long table toward the leader; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in a huge wine cellar dug into a hillside, with an oak-braced vault overhead and rows of casks along the walls. A long wooden table runs away from us down the middle of the picture, a row of candles burning along it, with fourteen halfling wagon-train leaders sitting on both sides, each with an open ledger in front of them, and every ledger open at its last page. A bowl of food steams in front of each person and no one has picked up a spoon. At the far end of the table three or four chairs stand empty. On every face a thin grey shadow clings like ash, hollowing the cheeks, and it does not brush off. In the near left foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands Todd, a halfling cook of about forty, small and plump, seen from behind at three-quarter: ginger hair clipped close to his scalp, tiny eyes, hands nicked and greasy from the knife, a flour-stained apron; he has just set down a big iron pot with both hands and stands with the ladle still in one fist, looking along the table. At the far end, small but sharp, sits Rose, a halfling wagon-train leader of fifty with grey-white curls under a headscarf embroidered with bees, honey-coloured eyes, deep laugh lines but the corners of her mouth turned down: from her belt hang seven small cart bells wrapped in cloth, and she has just unwrapped one with ink-stained fingers and is wrapping it again. Behind the head of the table, on the stairs, an old woman winemaker sits on a cask holding a jug. Dust motes drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是一幕里一桌人都不动勺子、托德看见每个人身上那一层灰影（源稿第436行和第449行）。萝丝腰上七只包布的车铃见第446行。

nodes.name: 饿狼的碗
nodes.light: warm orange of a small cooking fire from the lower right, with cold blue-grey night all round
nodes.camera: low and close beside the pot at ground level, looking across the wolf's bowl toward the cook; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the tail of a wagon on a hill road, with the dark shape of the canvas-covered wagon filling the upper left of the picture and a few other wagons far behind in the dark. A small fire burns on the ground under a little iron pot, and thin white steam rises from the pot in a straight line. On the right in the near foreground Todd, a halfling cook of about forty, small and plump, squats beside the pot with the ladle in his hand: ginger hair clipped close to his scalp, tiny eyes squeezed shut in a smile, hands covered in knife nicks, a flour-stained apron. He has just filled a wooden bowl and pushed it across the ground. At the left of the picture a starving wild wolf stands over the bowl, large and sharp in the foreground, its ribs showing under a patchy grey coat, its jaws that had been clamped on a basket of spring onions now opened, the basket dropped at its feet; the thin white steam curls round its nose and its eyes are half closed as it begins to lick. Behind Todd stands a boy of fifteen or sixteen, a halfling apprentice with a round face, a bundle of spring onions held to his chest and a chopping knife in his belt, watching with his mouth open. Behind him on the wagon steps a man sits with an empty bowl in both hands; a thin grey shadow that clung to his hollow cheeks is fading as he lifts the empty bowl away from his face. Steam and sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是二幕托德夜里在车尾炖小锅、饿狼松了牙舔碗（源稿第456到457行）。提姆没有立绘，照第496行写十五六岁、圆脸。

nodes.name: 一线白汽
who: the halfling cook sitting at the fire
nodes.light: warm orange firelight on the cook and the pot, cold grey-blue and ash shadow on the great beast behind, one thin white line of steam lit from below
nodes.camera: low behind the cook's shoulder at ground level, looking up past the pot at the beast's half-open eye; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at the bottom of a deep valley whose roof of fallen stone covers half the sky. The ground is covered in bones, men's, horses' and cart axles, and a small clear space has been cleared in the middle. In the near foreground at the lower left sits Todd, a halfling cook of about forty, small and plump, seen from behind at three-quarter, one cheek visible: ginger hair clipped close to his scalp, a flour-stained apron, a huge iron pot on a low fire in front of him and half a wagon-load of sacks and jars stacked at his side; he has not turned his head, one hand holds the ladle and the other rests on the rim of the pot. Leaning against a boulder behind the fire, blades outward, stand a row of swords and knives that earlier hunters left in the bones. A single thin white line of steam rises from the pot and goes straight up, past the beast and the fallen stone, to a narrow gap at the top of the valley. Filling the whole upper right half of the picture lies the beast, a grey hill-sized mound with a mottled hide that shows faint traces of green and orange, small eyes, and a huge mouth; its head is lowered toward him over its forelegs, one small eye half open in the firelight, its breath moving the steam. A thin grey shadow of hunger hangs over it like a second skin. Ash and glowing embers drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是三幕托德背对灰潮坐在锅前、那根白线一直升到谷顶（源稿第470到472行）。灰潮用第二阶（饱卧）的参考。

nodes.name: 凹痕
who: the halfling cook with the pot on his back
nodes.light: red-gold sunrise from the valley mouth behind them lighting the long cloud from beneath, cool grey shade in the foreground
nodes.camera: low on the slope below them, looking up at the two small figures against the red cloud; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise at the mouth of a stony valley. In the middle of the picture on a slope of broken rock, two halfling figures stand facing each other. On the left Todd, a halfling cook of about forty, small and plump: ginger hair clipped close to his scalp, tiny eyes squeezed in a tired smile, a flour-stained apron, a huge iron pot strapped on his back, its rim bearing a fresh dent like a bite mark, a few sparks of the dead fire still clinging to its side; he has just slapped the edge of it with one hand. Facing him stands Rose, a wagon-train leader of fifty: grey-white curls under a headscarf embroidered with bees, honey-coloured eyes, seven cloth-wrapped cart bells at her belt, her ink-stained fingers half lifted, her mouth open on a question. At her side a round-faced apprentice boy of fifteen holds a bundle of firewood and looks up at the cook with his eyes wide. Behind them, filling the lower end of the valley, a grey mound of a hill-sized beast lies collapsed on its side with its head on the ground, its eyes shut and its thin grey hunger-shadow slumped off it like a dropped cloak. From the top of the valley a long wide cloud, that began as a single white line of steam from a pot, has spread across the whole sky, its underside burning red in the sunrise. A group of wagons and tents wait small and far at the valley mouth. Warm steam and sparks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 选的是收束里托德背着锅出谷、萝丝迎上去问饭呢（源稿第478到479行），背景里是天亮时那一条白线铺成的长云（第475行）。灰潮倒下，用第二阶参考画卧倒的样子。

notes: 旅伴和相遇里萝丝约4850年死在穴镇，在这一段4830年的尾巴以外，没写死期，等主会话定。
娜卡按生年4580算死时一百二十八岁，卡特琳九十一，塔赫八十六，茵莉九十，都是照源稿的生年和死年算的，岁数偏大，页上要不要标等主会话定。
托卡是传奇，传给下一段，这一段不写死期。
托德下落不明，只写了一条下落不明的死期，没有给他画死的那一刻。
四位旅伴的死都是老死或平静的最后一刻，我都画成他们最后做的那一件事，不画倒下，raw 没有开。
二幕里娜卡的左耳缺口画成结了痂的伤，不画血。提姆、两位伯爵、狼耳和鹿耳的首领没有立绘，都在 text 里写了样子。
b2、b3、b4、a3 里出现的塔赫十八九岁，没有画他受伤。a3 里八岁的孩子只画一双脚，没有身子和脸。

布兰.how: 他死在车上，车停在一座祭火院的门口，马自己拉着他回了丘陵。账本最后一页有一行划掉了。

卡特琳.how: 她后来当了麦桥城西门的门长，西门的印一直是麦秆色的，东陆各地的城门守兵问人问三句，说是麦桥城西门起的头。她死在麦桥城。

塔赫.how: 他牵着那条灰狗追上往东去的娜卡，跟着她跑了十几年，后来当了狼耳的说和人。每回进别的帐子递完盐，他用左手摸一下自己的左耳。他死在青坡猎场。

娜卡.where: 蜜酒丘陵边上的祭火院
娜卡.how: 约4700年她不跑了，在祭火院里坐着收信，谁来问路她都答。4706年开春她把搓了一冬的麻绳送给了一个从高原上下来的年轻猎户。她老死在祭火院里，信袋一直背着。

茵莉.how: 她的腿接上了，走路一瘸一拐，往后是村里数日子的人，那头兽下山以前十天，她在村口敲木头。她死在崖下的村子。

托德.label: 下落不明
托德.how: 约4830年以后没有人再见过他。锅留在了穴镇，谁也说不准是哪一户的哪一口。

later_deaths.name: 最后一印
later_deaths.light: warm orange lantern light from the left against the deep blue of dusk, a straw-coloured glow at the stamped cloth
later_deaths.camera: at the height of her shoulder, from the side, looking along her arm to the stamp and the cart cloth; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: dusk at the west gate of a walled wheat-country city, an iron lantern burning on a bracket beside the arch. In the middle of the picture an old woman of ninety stands at the gate, seen in profile at three-quarter: still tall though a little bent, white hair cut at the chin, an old scar cutting her left eyebrow, ink-blue eyes unblinking and steady, a thin lined face and a mouth pressed in a line like a door seam, in a plain grey long coat with a leather belt and a badge of a bridge wound with wheat on the breast. Her right arm is stretched out and quite steady: her hand presses a small bronze stamp onto the corner of a canvas cart cover that comes into the picture from the right edge, partly cut off, and the new mark glows a soft straw colour and lights her wrist and sleeve. Her left hand rests on a long spear with a straw-coloured tassel that leans against the wall at her side. Through the open window of the gate lodge behind her, a pair of old cavalry boots hangs from a peg on the wall. Beyond the arch behind her the road runs away across wheat to the dusk, a single beacon glowing small on a far wall. Wheat chaff and dust motes lit orange drift large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 照源稿她当了西门门长、约4480年死在麦桥城（第597行），按年岁约九十一。画她最后盖印的那一下，门楼里那一双骑兵靴见第593行。

later_deaths.name: 最后一封
later_deaths.light: soft warm gold of a late-spring afternoon from the right, with blue shadow under the temple porch
later_deaths.camera: low, from the foot of the temple steps, looking up at the seated old woman and the road beyond; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: a late-spring afternoon at the stone steps of a small ward-fire temple on the edge of a green hill country dotted with beehives. In the middle of the picture on the top step sits Naka, an old fox-eared messenger, seen from the front at three-quarter: her long ponytail has turned grey with only a trace of fox red left in it, her two fox ears are grey at the tips with the white tufts almost gone and the left ear has an old notch healed smooth, deep lines at the corners of her amber eyes, a small crooked fang showing in a gentle smile, freckles faded on her nose. She wears a short deerskin jacket with a hundred small cloth strips sewn on its sleeves, worn soft, and across her lap lies a deerskin satchel so thickly patched with mismatched pieces that no original leather is left; her hand rests flat on it. She is looking down the road. A young girl messenger of about ten, out of breath and dusty, has just stopped at the foot of the steps, holding up a folded letter in both hands. Behind them on the green slope a line of cloth-wrapped carts hung with small bells winds along the road away from us toward the horizon. Pollen and petals drift large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 照源稿她约4700年起在蜜酒丘陵边祭火院收信、约4708年老死在那里、信袋一直背着（第661行）。年岁照生年4580算一百二十八。这里画她最后一回坐在院门前收信，不画倒下。年岁大是因为灵格那一层的寿数（第672行）。

later_deaths.name: 递盐
later_deaths.light: low red-gold sun from the right across the long grass, a faint pale glow in the worn path at his feet
later_deaths.camera: at the height of his chest, from the side, looking along his offered hand toward the far pole; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: a late-autumn evening on a long gold grass slope under a high plateau. In the middle of the picture, between two white-peeled poles that stand a mile apart, one barely visible far down the slope on the left and the other far down on the right, a narrow trodden path glows faintly pale in the grass, and at its centre stands Tahe, an old wolf-eared man of eighty-six seen in profile at three-quarter, tall and lean though stooped: grey-white untidy hair, two upright wolf ears whose silver backs have gone white at the edges, pale ice-blue eyes cast down first as always, an old dog-scratch scar down his cheek, a plain fur vest and a leather pouch at his belt. His right hand is held out with a pinch of salt held between thumb and finger toward a thin deer-eared elder who stands in front of him at the right, partly cut off by the frame, with a piece of antler tucked into his white temple hair and one palm held open to receive it. His own left hand has come halfway up toward his left ear and not yet reached it. At his feet a very old grey dog lies stretched on the glowing path with its head on its paws. Behind them on the slope a few wolf-eared and deer-eared elders sit in a ragged line in the grass, bows laid aside. Dry seeds and stalks drift large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 照源稿他后来当了狼耳的说和人，每回递盐后摸一下自己的左耳，约4668年死在青坡猎场（第320行、第714行）。年岁照生年4582算八十六。这里画他递盐、手抬到一半，是他的一个习惯，不画倒下。

later_deaths.name: 敲木头
later_deaths.light: pale grey-gold light of an overcast late morning from the left, with a darker band of storm cloud high on the right
later_deaths.camera: at her eye level, from the side, looking along her arm to the hanging log and the cliff beyond; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: a late-morning in a hunters' village under a high cliff, stone houses with slate roofs and a thin line of cloud streaking the sky above. In the middle of the picture at the village mouth stands Inri, a human woman of ninety, seen in profile at three-quarter: a long white-flax braid with a storm-hawk feather tied in its end, and beside it a single crackling hair that holds a faint violet spark, grey-blue eyes narrowed as she looks high up, a thin lined face with one corner of her mouth lifting, in a leather coat with a worn down collar. She leans on a crutch with one stiff leg, and with her other hand raises a wooden mallet to strike a hollow log that hangs from a rope between two posts, her arm caught at the top of the swing. In front of the door of a house at the left stands a frame of poles and rope laid like a stretcher, with pine nuts drying on it in the sun and an old short bow lying across it, its string slack. At the right of the picture, high above the cliff edge, a dark mass of cloud has begun to press down, only the first edge of it showing. A frozen waterfall hangs in the cliff behind her. Small children are climbing onto a roof in the middle distance, pointing up. Snowflakes and drifting feathers of down float large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 照源稿她是村里数日子的人，那头兽下山以前十天在村口敲木头，约4790年死在崖下（第837行）。年岁照生年4700算九十。担架上晒松子见第832行，她辫子上那一根毛是托卡给的。画她最后敲木头，不画倒下。
